'''Corran Antillies Abyssins are broken''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Corran Antillies]]
* '''Published:''' 17 June 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 MKOS Antillies DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Lando Calrissian (V), Jabba's Influence (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This deck is a standard abyssin swarm deck.  It's my secondary deck, but has been doing some serious damage.  And yes, I did steal the idea from Ice Breath.  *Please don't rate, this deck sucks.

== Notes ==

* Posted Lando V dested Lando Calrissian (V) (Virtual Set 6); Jabba's Influence V dested Jabba's Influence (V) (Virtual Set 6).
* ovs_pick returned a Virtual Set 7+ page for Lando Calrissian (V) (Virtual Set 15) because sets 7+ are treated as legal from 2004-06-01; the code comment says 'only after 2004', so the newest Virtual Set 1-6 printing is used: Lando Calrissian (V) (Virtual Set 6).
* Posted POTH dested Power Of The Hutt; His name's Ani dested His Name Is Anakin; Scum dested Scum And Villainy. Myo x3 is the representative.

== Strategy ==

Swarm with abyssins.  That's about all there is to it.  Scum and Chall make abyssins free unless your opponent plays the Camp.  Ree-Yees is broken in this deck, because he adds 3 to any destiny of 3 and all your abyssins are destiny 3.  Also, watto w/ watto's chance cube and Lando V or Ree-Yees when you're flipped with Jabba and Bib on table (Doesn't happen too often, but has happened before) goes something like this.  play watto's chance cube, Draw destiny, get a 3, add either 1 or 3 depending on who it is that's adding. Destiny=4or6(even, so chance cube adds 2 destiny).  Add 2 with the Objective. Destiny=6 or 8.  Then with each of your other two destinies add with the objective and maybe Ree-Yees.  you come up with a total destiny somewhere btwn 11 and 24.  All the POTH people are in there to hold the AC.  I gues that's it.
